answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 13463 Country: DE Title: is it possible to make friendship with non muslims?? 2. is it possible to do business as partners with non muslims? Question: is it possible to make friendship with non muslims?? 2. is it possible to do business as partners with non muslims? Answer ID: 13463 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 924/924=M/1430) (1) One should not be bosom friend. (2) Business in partnership is alright if there is no unlawful business and the transactions are made according to Shariah compliant principles. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
